contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = $5,253.53 on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and its 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)', both $5253.53
contributions.detail: 6 Schedule A rows on p2: 250.00 + 100.00 + 300.00 + 350.00 + 2,000.00 + 2,253.53 = 5,253.53 EXACTLY, equal to all three printed figures (page subtotal, sum-of-all-pages total, and the promoted per-period Box B). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 5,253.53 because this is the cycle's FIRST report, so period and year-to-date coincide; the cumulative cell is still not summed as an increment. The grid has 15 printed rows and 9 are empty (crop-proved), so there is no second Schedule A sheet and the 'sum of all pages' figure is this page's own subtotal.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 5,433.81 on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' and its 'Total Expenditures Made', both $5,433.81
expenditures.detail: 9 Schedule B rows on p3: 1,732.36 + 1,559.25 + 1,099.58 + 32.17 + 36.43 + 75.08 + 218.22 + 662.27 + 18.45 = 5,433.81 EXACTLY = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Box D. Box E year-to-date prints the same 5,433.81 (first report of the cycle). NOTE a cover-level filer arithmetic slip that touches NEITHER side and is retained verbatim: Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures (Box A + Box B)' prints 5,415.36 where A + B = 180.28 + 5,253.53 = 5,433.81 — an 18.45 shortfall exactly equal to the last-listed Schedule B row (Maceys, 18.45), and 5,415.36 is also the running sum of the first EIGHT Schedule B rows; the close box then prints $0.00 where F - D would be -18.45. Both cells are transcribed as printed by the cover tranche and nothing was nudged: the two SIDES each close exactly on their own printed anchors.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable — this is the `v. 4.20` blank, whose Schedule A and Schedule B carry NO in-kind column and no in-kind checkbox, and no row on either schedule is annotated in-kind in any way. Tested on this filing rather than inherited from the same filer's other 2022 filing, which DOES carry one in-kind item on his own spreadsheet — the conventions differ between this filer's own two reports, exactly as §G1 warns.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: the cover prints 'Rodney W Mann' where index.csv's channel label is 'Rodd Mann' and the filename says 'Mann_Rodney'; the filer signs his Schedule A rows as 'Rod Mann'. The page face governs and all spellings are recorded without adjudication — the channel spells this filer two ways across the corpus and the divergence must stay visible. THE OFFICE BOX IS BLANK ON THE FORM, and so are Phone and Email: nothing about the office is inferred here; index.csv's 'County Auditor' is a channel attribution, not evidence from this page. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding Convention'; the amendment question IS answered here ('No' ticked) — unlike this same filer's later 2022 filing, where it is left wholly blank. Date of Report 4/4/2022. DOCUMENT SHAPE: 6 pages, all read full-page — p1 cover (v. 4.20, Josh Daniels masthead), p2 Schedule A (foliated 'Page 2'), p3 Schedule B ('Page 3'), p4 SUMMARY PAGE ('Page 4'), p5 the Elections Division's CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST, p6 blank. Every page was classified from its own printed heading. THE CHECKLIST is at p5 of 6, the HOLD / 'Staff Signature #1' / '#2' revision, with the 'Website' and 'Network' boxes ticked and 'HOLD' not; two staff review copies dated 4/4/22 (red) and 4/9/2022 (purple), and the purple reviewer has CIRCLED the line 'Does the subtotal of contributions match the total of the listed itemized contributions?'. It is a clerk work product, carries no dollar figures, and is not a summary page. TWO MASTHEAD VINTAGES ALTERNATE SHEET BY SHEET within this one filing: 'Josh Daniels Clerk/Auditor' on pp1 and 3, 'Amelia Powers Gardner Clerk/Auditor' on pp2 and 4 — the §L6 pattern, here alternating rather than sectional. THE FILER'S OWN FORM CHOICE DIFFERS BETWEEN HIS TWO 2022 FILINGS: this April report is filled out on the county's own Schedule A / Schedule B / Summary Page, while his October report substitutes his own typed spreadsheet for all three. Neither predicts the other. REDACTION: this filing IS named '_Redacted' and the county blacked out the candidate's address block and his signature on the cover, plus the street portion of every donor address on Schedule A — and on ONE row (Vern May) the bar also covers the city. His October filing, by contrast, is published entirely in the clear including his own street address. Same filer, same cycle, opposite redaction practice (§K4), and redaction is judged per cell here. OBSERVATION, used for nothing and cited only so the coordinator has it: this report's Schedule B lists nine expenditures totalling 5,433.81, while the same filer's later whole-cycle spreadsheet shows TEN rows for the same pre-April period, the extra one being a 25-Mar Costco 'Ink Cartridges for Flyes' of 186.40. That is a difference between two documents, not a defect in either; this filing closes exactly on its own printed figures and nothing from the other document was imported.
